# vyos_container_image (Resource)

Ensures a digest-pinned container image is cached on VyOS using the container-image API. Refresh detects a pruned image; apply pulls it again. Existing images are adopted without pulling. Destroy forgets the image without deleting shared cache content. Pulls do not use configuration commit-confirm or saving settings. Requires /container-image and show container image json support.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vyos_container_image" "booter" {
  image = "ghcr.io/siderolabs/booter@sha256:f2ee41daabd2e698184c0a6dc29fe9321aabc829fd18046be54c7da923b0cea3"
}

resource "vyos_config_batch" "booter" {
  entries = {
    booter_image = {
      path  = ["container", "name", "booter", "image"]
      value = vyos_container_image.booter.image
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Fully qualified repository@sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal digits> reference without a tag. Changing it requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The immutable image reference.
